data: What is the percentage of green line when the threshold type frequency is 10^3?

The red line represents the percentage of types covered, while the green line represents the percentage of sentences covered. The threshold type frequency is on the x-axis, which is logarithmic. The y-axis shows the percentage of coverage. When the threshold type frequency is 10^3, the green line is approximately at 25%. Therefore, the percentage of green line when the threshold type frequency is 10^3 is approximately 25%.
